_comment: Every value here was measured, not chosen. See ai/reports/onnx_verification.json and ai/reports/gate_report.json for the sweeps these came from. Editing this file retunes the deployed app without a code change.
_tau: Shipped operating point from MODEL_CARD.md section 5. Selected on the Mild-recall curve, not on balanced accuracy: 0.50 buys +4.5 points of early-case recall for 1.8 points of specificity. Do not raise it without re-reading that section.
_unclear: Dead-band routed to 'unclear'. Measured on the 611-image locked test split: abstains on 2.9% of photos, and on the ones still decided lifts recall 0.9629 -> 0.9746 and specificity 0.8551 -> 0.8593. Ten positives fall in the band; they are told to consult a vet anyway, so the safety action is unchanged.
_otherMax: Gate 1, softmax half: reject when P(other) >= this. Held-out (never trained on) species head: cattle->cattle 0.9967, buffalo->buffalo 1.0000, other->other 0.9885. 0.8 rather than 0.7 because the joint gate at 0.7 kept only 98.5% of the 611 held-out cattle test photos; at 0.8 it keeps 99.0%. The 6 cattle photos still turned away were inspected -- see ai/reports/gate_verification.json.
_oodMax: Gate 1, open-set half: reject when the Mahalanobis d^2 (PCA k=384) of the photo features from the bovine training distribution is >= this. The softmax alone called 20/20 real landscapes cattle with p=1.000; with this half added, 12/12 real landscapes on the dev machine are rejected. 746.1 is the 99.5th percentile of held-out cattle d^2 (buffalo 100% under it). Held-out AUROC non-animal vs animal 0.956. Combined with otherMax, real-animal retention is cattle 0.9902 / buffalo 1.0000 and 82.6% of 6,588 novel non-animal photos (scenes, faces, unseen object classes -- never trained on) are rejected at T=0.7; the exact figure at T=0.8 is pinned by kernel v7. Field rows store d^2 raw so this can be retuned without re-running anything.
_blur: Variance of the Laplacian on the 224x224 model input. 120 is the 0.5th percentile of the locked test split (min 20, median 969), so it rejects only genuinely unusable photos. Nine field photos from 2026-09-21/22 all passed it. Retune from the field distribution once there are a few hundred.
_clipped: Fraction of pixels crushed to black (luma <= 4) or blown to white (luma >= 251). 0.35 flags 1.8% of test images on the bright side and 0.2% on the dark side. Deliberately permissive: a marginal photo is still worth collecting, it just should not get a confident verdict.
